## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1540 invitations were issued across the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 74, giving a reported rate of 4.8. This result is recorded for monitoring purposes and provides a straightforward comparison between the number invited and the number who attended. The figures indicate that invitations reached a substantially larger group than the group ultimately attending. Maintaining a clear record of invitations and attendance supports routine review of outreach activity and helps inform future contact arrangements.

The information in this section reflects the invitation and attendance figures supplied for the report.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1317 were accompanied by an SMS message. The report records 0 reminder messages received. These contact figures are presented alongside the invitation and attendance information to support a consistent account of outreach activity. SMS contact was used for most invitations, while no reminder messages were recorded. The figures can be used for local review of contact processes and follow-up arrangements.

Prepared by G. Evans.
